summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a 6-K furnishing a press release on progress under its EUR 1.0 billion share buyback programme announced 30 April 2026. During 5-9 October 2026, the Dutch bank repurchased 2,300,000 shares at an average price of EUR 30.10 for EUR 69,237,510. Cumulative repurchases reached 32,710,805 shares at an average EUR 28.58, totaling EUR 934,815,400.49, or roughly 93.48% of the programme's maximum value. The programme's stated purpose is reducing share capital; no advisor or board recommendation is named. Watch execution pace and remaining authorization versus CET1 capital return guidance.
